articles.title: India Deep Ocean Mission: MATSYA 6000 Deep-Sea Submersible Trial Milestone
articles.summary: India's indigenous manned submersible MATSYA 6000 successfully advances deep ocean exploration trials under the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
prelims: MATSYA 6000 is developed by the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT), Chennai.
Targeted at exploring polymetallic nodules containing nickel, cobalt, copper, and manganese in the Central Indian Ocean Basin.
Nodal initiative under the National Deep Ocean Mission launched in 2021.
articles.mains: Examine the strategic and economic significance of India's Deep Ocean Mission in securing critical mineral supply chains for clean energy transition.

articles.title: Implementation of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) Digital Evidence Protocols
articles.summary: Union Home Ministry reviews nationwide implementation of mandatory digital evidence collection standards under the new criminal procedural framework.
prelims: BNSS mandates compulsory videography during search and seizure operations.
e-Sakshya portal serves as the centralized repository for forensic digital evidence handling.
Replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 to modernize investigation protocols.
articles.mains: Discuss how modernizing criminal justice laws through mandatory digital forensics improves conviction rates while addressing data integrity and privacy concerns.

articles.title: Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) Expansion Strategy for Global South
articles.summary: India accelerates the export of modular open-source DPI stacks to developing nations across Africa and Southeast Asia.
prelims: India Stack includes identity (Aadhaar), fast payments (UPI), and data governance (Account Aggregator).
Aligned with the G20 Framework for Systems of Digital Public Infrastructure endorsed during India's presidency.
Focuses on non-proprietary architecture to ensure technology sovereignty for recipient nations.
articles.mains: Analyze Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) as an instrument of soft power and economic diplomacy in India's foreign policy toward the Global South.

articles.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission: SIGHT Scheme Tranche-II Progress
articles.summary: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy reviews domestic electrolyzer manufacturing capacity under the SIGHT component.
prelims: SIGHT (Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition) offers financial incentives for electrolyzers and hydrogen production.
Targets production of 5 MMT (Million Metric Tonnes) of Green Hydrogen annually by 2030.
Nodal Ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).
articles.mains: Critically evaluate the infrastructure and financial bottlenecks in scaling up Green Hydrogen production for hard-to-abate industrial sectors in India.

articles.title: Western Ghats Ecologically Sensitive Area (ESA) Draft Notification
articles.summary: Environment Ministry updates draft notifications defining Ecologically Sensitive Areas across six Western Ghats states.
prelims: Kasturirangan Committee recommended declaring nearly 37% of the Western Ghats as Ecologically Sensitive Area.
Madhav Gadgil Commission originally recommended designating 90% of the Western Ghats as ESA.
Prohibits red-category polluting industries, mining, and large thermal power plants in ESA zones.
articles.mains: Discuss the challenge of balancing biodiversity conservation with the socio-economic development rights of local communities in fragile bio-regions like the Western Ghats.
